list.snippet: Over-the-counter pain relievers like NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen) or acetaminophen can help manage pain and inflammation. In some cases, muscle relaxants or stronger pain medications may be prescribed.

list.title: Physical Therapy:
list.snippet: Therapists can guide patients through exercises to strengthen back and core muscles, improve flexibility, and correct posture. This helps support the spine and reduce stress on affected areas.
